decisions.reason: As a finish and design extension very close to the firm’s core drainage know-how, it fits existing capabilities and the stronger 2024 website presence suggests the firm could absorb market feedback and commercialise it effectively.

This shower channel is tightly aligned with the firm’s established drainage, planning and installation competences, and its continued dedicated presentation in both 2023 and 2024 indicates solid traction and good scope for incremental improvement.

Although related to the core offer, the pump-assisted concept is more technologically demanding than the firm’s standard gravity-drainage products, and its disappearance from the website by 2024 signals weak market acceptance or limited ability to refine it profitably from existing knowledge.

As a newer pump-drain variant launched in 2024 with dedicated presentation, it appears to be the firm’s more current attempt to apply and extend what it learned from adjacent drainage technologies, so it is worth retaining while that learning is still fresh.
